description: Aljal Ipsi (알잘 입시): List admission schedule dates as written in the official guides. With a university name: that university's application, document, exam, and announcement dates. Without one: the nationwide common calendar (CSAT date, score release, application windows). Returns up to 30 dated lines in Korean, the source, the page URL, and a calendar file (.ics) URL. 학교별 입시 일정 또는 모든 수험생 공통 일정입니다.

from.description: Optional start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (Korea time).

school.description: Optional university name or short name in Korean, e.g. "서울대", "연세대". Omit for the nationwide common calendar. 비우면 공통 일정.

to.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days after the start.

name: get_admission_schedule
title: 입시 일정 보기
